instagram.caption:
The paper with no verdict.
The Landing Zone in the Entryway. The spot where pockets empty on the way in and refill on the way out.

What done looks like:
1. One tray holding keys and sunglasses
2. One phone per adult
3. A single upright folder with fewer than ten sheets of paper standing in it
4. Bare surface on both sides of the tray

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success landing zone.
